(gusperimus) Profile Gusperimus is a guanidine derivative that inhibits both cell-me- diated and antibody-mediated immunity. It is used in the treat- ment of renal graft rejection, and has been investigated in the management of graft-versus-host disease and Wegener’s granu- lomatosis.
